content:
Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi is starring in a new paranormal investigation series, "Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie". The eight-episode show premieres on All Reality on November 13, 2026.

Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie will premiere on streamer All Reality

The reality star will investigate paranormal activity at locations across Ontario, Canada. Psychic medium Kevin Whitaker, occult expert and historian Missy Morrow, and paranormal technology specialist Todd Thomas will join her. As a newcomer to paranormal investigations, Snooki will rely heavily on her team.

Courtney Thomasma, executive vice president of Linear and Streaming at AMC Global Media, welcomed the new addition to the streamer's programming. "Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi helped define reality television for a generation, and we're incredibly excited to welcome her back to AMC Global Media for this entertaining and unexpected paranormal adventure," Thomasma said.

She added, "Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie delivers everything All Reality fans love: big personalities, addictive stories and a stranger-than-fiction twist. Who better to take us into the unknown this Friday the 13th than Snooki?"

The US premiere follows the series' Canadian launch on Crave on October 2. According to Bell Media's official announcement, the show visits historic locations across Ontario, including Tuckett Mansion, Fulford Place, Huron Historic Gaol and Old Fort Erie.

Snooki has long been interested in the paranormal, making the show a natural fit for her. Speaking to Interview Magazine in 2024, Snooki broached the subject of her paranormal interest. She described herself as a firm believer in the paranormal and discussed her experiences with UFOs, ghosts, and other unexplained phenomena.

She recalled seeing what she believed was a UFO when she was 13. "I was laying out by my mom's pool and it was a gorgeous day, no clouds in the sky." She also described seeing a light that moved erratically before stopping and disappearing. Weeks later, she reportedly had a vivid dream involving three beings, which she interpreted as an encounter with aliens.

The show is produced by Buck Productions in association with My Entertainment and Bell Media's Crave. It is directed by Kyle Whitelaw, who also serves as showrunner.
